scenarios.title: Idle dedicated macOS host only: launch quirkyd with a fresh temporary QUIRKY_HOME and a real Heimdall watcher with observable work in flight. Arrange a safe external/manual wake before requesting real system sleep. Observe that native SystemWillSleep fences pending decisions before acknowledgment; on confirmed wake the watcher reads live state and cannot blindly replay its previous attempt. Never run on an active shared build host.

Idle dedicated macOS host only: record a watcher's active budget and its interval-close timestamp, sleep the real host for a known interval, then wake. Verify budget excludes the sleeping gap and a new live reconciliation occurs. Stop the daemon, start a new isolated daemon and repeat to establish native notifier/source/callback cleanup. Do not claim this from synthetic lifecycle events or registration-only smoke.
